scope: Byte-domain HSV reciprocals and admission-proven single-query source blocks inside nested traversal. Whole-frame entry points keep contiguous upstream evaluation. No new retained sampled-frame cache. Wire format remains 42.

method.device: ESP32 rev3.1, 240 MHz, one core, Wi-Fi off, GPIO untouched. Standalone profiling firmware, Cargo release opt-level 3, fat LTO, one codegen unit. Instruction counting is disabled during device timing.
method.window: 32 frame evaluations including first use. Profiling controls bracket 997/1999 us PC sampling. The profiler checks its two-second deadline after each frame, avoiding overflow on slow workloads. Self-symbol percentages are sampled attribution, not independently timed functions.
method.workload: 600 pixels, four simultaneous starter effects (ScanSweep, ImpactBurst, SparkleComet, ShimmerField), followed by HueShift(0.13), Echo(75 ms, two repeats, decay 0.5), and Dim(0.8). Echo includes the current sample and two delayed samples, evaluating twelve effect-pixel samples per output pixel. The window starts at 3 seconds and advances by 8333 us.
method.limits: Prepared evaluation and output encoding only. Excludes network, storage, DMA and physical output. No laptop timings. A 60 fps budget remains far out of reach for this deliberately heavy mixed workload; the optimization goal is unfinished. General numeric VM lanes and program fusion remain unimplemented.

equivalence.rounding: In the new mixed workload, reciprocal math changes 84 of 57600 RGB channels across 32 frames, at most one byte level (1/255). Changes occur in 29 frames. The user explicitly accepts small floating-point rounding differences. Device captures use the corresponding pre/post-math host goldens; scheduling itself preserves all 640 current-math checksums.

validation: cargo fmt and the final fresh pnpm check passed, including frontend checks, 80 desktop tests (one existing hardware test ignored), 115 runtime unit tests, 11 allocation tests, temporal integration coverage, 16 device-storage tests, and all-target/all-feature workspace Clippy with warnings denied. Nine focused staging tests cover scalar/block parity, branches, arrays, loops, tails, seeks and addressing. The exhaustive schema suite passed in 584.05 seconds. The final gate used RUST_TEST_THREADS=4 and the configured host libclang. An earlier overlapping check hit Windows LNK1104 while a previous schema test executable was running; the fresh complete rerun passed after that process ended. Full controller release also builds and links. Final log: target/vm-opt-20261002/single-query-verified-check.log.

memory.note: Retained means allocator-used playback bytes, excluding stack. Existing whole-frame source buffers remain available at whole-frame entry points. No cache-hit measurement.

regression_investigation: Applying single-query blocks at whole-frame entry points initially slowed Stanford to 23928 us and raised dispatches to 21908.9375/frame. That split an already contiguous upstream frame pass into repeated setup/traversal. Preserving whole-frame scheduling and applying the optimization inside existing nested blocks restores 14403.9375 dispatches and 13424 us while retaining the mixed-workload improvement. FreezeBlack increases by 114 us (4.2%, warm +121.5 us); its bytecode counts are unchanged and the added source bookkeeping/traversal is consistent with the extra sampled cost. This small absolute tradeoff is recorded rather than adding another execution path.
stack_note: Individual native entry reservations, not maximum nested stack use.
